name: hcapp_getRunsTogether
description: The hasher page (E10.F1.S5, shared with E9.F1.S26's search results): who the other hasher is, a summary, and every run the caller and they BOTH attended (AttendenceState >= 20, not removed, run visible and live — the HC6.CoRunners rule per run), newest first. Only runs the CALLER attended can appear, so nothing here is new to them. Runs carry what a past-run card needs (HC.Event's activity counts), so the page does not depend on which old runs the phone still holds. Auth: HC6.ValidateAppAuth (spNumber 145, @param NULL). Looking up a removed/deleted hasher, an unknown public id, or yourself: errorCode 14500, errorType 3.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Short-lived token (standard, device secret). Default NULL.

parameters.name: otherPublicHasherId
parameters.description: The other hasher's PUBLIC id (HC.Hasher.PublicHasherId). NULL, unknown, removed, deleted, or the caller's own: 14500/3 (logged).

rowsets.description: Error shape differs by path: on auth failure (ValidateAppAuth) the error detail ALONE at index 0; on 14500 (not found / yourself, errorType 3) and on 14501 (unhandled, errorType 5, from the CATCH block after ROLLBACK and an HC.ErrorLog row) a { success=0, errorCode, errorType } envelope at index 0 followed by this detail at index 1.

rowsets.name: Envelope
rowsets.description: Success envelope (line 91), after the #runs temp table is built and before the data rowsets.

rowsets.name: Hasher

columns.name: HomeKennelName
columns.description: HC.Kennel.KennelName of HomeKennelId; NULL when none or the kennel is deleted.

rowsets.description: One row — the other hasher and the summary.

rowsets.name: Runs

columns.name: MyRunNumber
columns.description: the caller's run number at that kennel at this run, historical count included (added 2026-10-02)

columns.name: MyHareNumber
columns.description: the caller's haring number at that kennel, historical included (added 2026-10-02)

columns.name: TrackRunnerCount
columns.description: PackTrack runners on the run — HC.Event's activity count (added 2026-10-02)

columns.name: MessageCount
columns.description: run chat messages — HC.Event's activity count (added 2026-10-02)

rowsets.description: One row per run both attended, ORDER BY EventStartDatetimeGmt DESC.

sideEffects: CREATE TABLE #runs (dropped when the procedure ends), lines 72-89
INSERT HC.ErrorLog on 14500 (lines 58-60) and from the CATCH block (lines 126-127, after ROLLBACK)

codeSmells.issue: Two error shapes in one SP
codeSmells.detail: An auth failure returns the detail row alone (lines 46-47) while the SP's own errors return envelope + detail (lines 61-63, 128-130). A client reading rowset 0 by column copes; one reading by position does not.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
